steps.text: Good habits during adolescence set you up for a healthy life. Let's pick some.
Tap each healthy habit to see why it helps.
Key habits: enough sleep, regular exercise or play, drinking water, eating well, and screen-time in balance.
These habits give you energy, help you grow, and keep your mind fresh. Small daily choices add up to big results.

coach.mission: Choose healthy daily habits for adolescence.
whenStuck: Tap each habit to see how it helps your body and mind.
Think about sleep, exercise, water, and food.
whenWrong: Healthy habits include enough sleep, exercise, water, and good food.
Balance matters — including limiting screen time.
whenCorrect: Right — that's a habit that keeps you healthy.
Good — small daily habits add up over time.
coach.done: You've chosen healthy habits for adolescence. Explore more, or move on when you're ready.
